description: Defines the UDPClientSocket class for UDP network communication, including its constructors, methods for connecting, reading, writing, and socket management, as well as internal socket handling.

classes.name: UDPClientSocket
classes.description: A socket class for UDP communication, supporting connection, reading, writing, and socket configuration.

methods.name: UDPClientSocket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UDP socket with optional network binding.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetwork
methods.description: Connects the socket using a specific network handle.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Connects the socket using the default network.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects to the specified endpoint.

methods.name: ConnectUsingNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects using a specific network handle.

methods.name: ConnectUsingDefaultNetworkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously connects using the default network.

methods.name: GetBoundNetwork
methods.description: Returns the network handle the socket is bound to.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic management.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from the buffer to the socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket.

methods.name: GetPeerAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote peer address.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket address.

methods.name: UseNonBlockingIO
methods.description: Switches socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: SetMsgConfirm
methods.description: Enables message confirmation.

methods.name: NetLog
methods.description: Returns the network log source.

methods.name: EnableRecvOptimization
methods.description: Enables receive optimization.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the multicast interface.

methods.name: SetIOSNetworkServiceType
methods.description: Sets the iOS network service type.

methods.name: AdoptOpenedSocket
methods.description: Takes ownership of an existing socket.
